translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

book.name: 2 Korintiya
book.title: Ukanikorongi u Ire Ubana a Asu u Aza a Korintiya

content: Gogo‑na gita̱ ɗa tsa gita̱ ucikpala kaci ka tsunu? Ama roku a rawa ta̱ n ikanikorongi i icikpali ko kpam a zuwa ɗa̱ i koronku le ikanikorongi i icikpali yi. U gan tsu yain n ikanikorongi nala?
Shegai eɗa ukanikorongi u tsunu, kpam iꞌa̱ ta̱ a asuvu a atakasuvu a tsunu tsa̱ra̱ ya dem u yain ka̱neshi u reve kpam iꞌya u yain ka̱neshi vi.

I wenike ta̱ a kateshe an eɗa ikanikorongi iꞌya Kawauwi ka korongi aku a̱tsu tsu bankai iꞌya. Kulu Keri ku Kashila̱ Uza u Uma ku korongu ɗa̱ ta̱ a asuvu a atakasuvu a tsunu, shegai a iwara̱ka ko agbagala a ɗa a yain n atali wa.
Tsa fuɗa ta̱ tsa dana nala adama a ucira u upityanangu u tsunu a kapala ka Kashila̱ adama a Kawauwi.
Dana ɗa tsu danai tsa fuɗa tsa yan manyan ma nala mi n kaci ka tsunu wa. Kashila̱ ka ka zuwai tsu fuɗai tsu yain gba̱ iꞌya tsu yain vi.

U zuwa tsu ta̱ tsu fuɗa tsu woko agbashi a kazuwamgbani ka savu ka ne ka ka wuta̱i a asu u Kulu Keri. Kazuwamgbani ka savu ki Mele ma a korongi wa, kpaci Mele ma a korongi ma tsu tuko ta̱ ukpa̱, shegai Kulu ku tsu tuko ta̱ uma.

Mele ma cau a atali a ɗa a tsu korongu ma, kpam a tsu wene ta̱ tsupige tsu Kashila̱ a aꞌayin a nala yi. Aza a Isaraꞌila a fuɗa a ɓa̱ra̱kpa̱ n a wundi upetiwaꞌeshi u Musa wa, kpaci wa laɗa ta̱ cika, ko an u wokoi ulaɗa vi u ɓa̱ra̱kpa̱ wa. Adama a nala, Mele ma ma wokoi manyan ma ne utuko u ukpa̱ u ɗa, kpam ma̱ri n tsupige nala,
tsupige tsu manyan ma Kulu Keri tsu la ta̱ tsupige tsu Mele. Ko nala wa?
Manyan ma ma tsu tuko ama ukiɗa̱ga u ugana n mavura ma̱ baci n tsupige, manyan ma ma tsu zuwa ama a woko ama a maci a kapala ka Kashila̱ ma yan ta̱ n tsupige tsa tsa la nala vi.
Mayun ɗa an tsupige tsu kazuwamgbani ka cau tsu woko ɗe ili i gbani, kpaci katyashi ka tsupige tsu savu ka la ta̱ ka cau.
Mele ma̱ ta̱ n tsupige tsa tsu kporoi. Shegai tsupige tsu kazuwamgbani ka savu tsu la ta̱ ucira, kpaci tsa kporo wa.
Tsa dansa ta̱ bawu uwonvo, kpaci adama a nala a ɗa tsa̱ri n uzuwa u uma.
Tsa̱ tyoku u Musa wa. Upetiwaꞌeshi ne u laɗa ta̱, shegai u pala ta̱ u ɗa tsa̱ra̱ u zuwa aza a Isaraꞌila a lyai kelime n uwene katyashi ki n ka kpori wa.
Ama yi a ryagbaja ta̱, kpam ili i roku i tsu ka̱ngu le ta̱ uwene ukuna u mayun aꞌayin a ɗa baci a yain ka̱neshi u Mele. Kawauwi ka koshi ka fuɗa ka takpa le ili iꞌya i ka̱ngu le uwene vi.
Ko n gogo‑na, a yan baci ka̱neshi u Mele ma Musa, ili iꞌya pini i tsu ka̱ngu le atakasuvu.
Shegai aꞌayin a ɗa baci dem uza kpatalai ubana a asu u Asheku, she u takpa yi ili iꞌya i ka̱ngu yi vi.
Asheku a nala yi aya Kulu. Kpam asu ɗa baci dem Kulu ku Magono ma Zuba ka̱ri, ku tsu na̱ka̱ ta̱ utsa̱ra̱ u kaci.

Adama a nala ipetiyaꞌeshi i tsunu iꞌa̱ kpam upali wa, tsa̱ra̱ tsu wenike tsupige tsu Magono ma Zuba. Kpam Kulu ku Magono ma Zuba ka yan baci manyan a asuvu a tsunu, tsa woko ta̱ tyoku u ne aku tsu wenike tsupige tsu ne cika.
